        if ((b & 1) > 0) ans *= a; 
        a *= a; 
        b >>= 1; 
    } 
    return ans; 
}

void shuffle(vector<int>& a) {
    int n = a.size() - 1;
    static random_device rd;
    static mt19937 gen(rd());
    uniform_int_distribution<> dis(0, n);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        int ind = dis(gen) % (n - i + 1) + i;
        int swap_val = a[i];
        a[i] = a[ind];
        a[ind] = swap_val;
    }
}
